reply.answer_text: The Money Purchase Annual Allowance is £10,000 per year. It is triggered when you take taxable pension income through flexi-access drawdown (FAD income) or any uncrystallised funds pension lump sum (UFPLS). Taking only a tax-free lump sum (PCLS) with no taxable income does not trigger it.
